setup.name: system
setup.command: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs --no-install-recommends && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

setup.name: uv
setup.command: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && sudo ln -sf $HOME/.local/bin/uv /usr/local/bin/uv && sudo ln -sf $HOME/.local/bin/uvx /usr/local/bin/uvx

setup.name: pnpm
setup.command: (command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo npm install -g corepack) && sudo corepack enable && sudo corepack prepare pnpm@11.8.0 --activate

setup.name: chunk-testsuite
setup.command: (command -v circleci >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fLSs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CircleCI-Public/circleci-cli/master/install.sh | bash) && curl -fLO https://circleci-binary-releases.s3.amazonaws.com/circleci-cli-plugins/circleci-testsuite/1.0.44205-511b6d4/linux/amd64/circleci-testsuite.gz && echo "c7a4fd0e5489e72f576cbef4cbcc19c73802602bad76acb909d71cff91f02f70  circleci-testsuite.gz" | sha256sum -c - && gunzip -f circleci-testsuite.gz && sudo install -m 0755 circleci-testsuite /usr/local/bin/circleci-testsuite
